value.markup:
crombolo components check

Compile every component, and report one a type declares with no file. Changes nothing.

crombolo components check

crombolo components list

What is in components/, and which type declares each. Changes nothing.

crombolo components list

crombolo components new

Components/<alias>.tsx; the alias may carry folders. Each run acts again.

crombolo components new <alias>
ArgumentWhat it is
aliasThe component's alias. Required.

crombolo assets list

The stylesheets and scripts this site has. Changes nothing.

crombolo assets list

crombolo assets new

Write an empty stylesheet or script in the place the backoffice edits. Each run acts again.

crombolo assets new <kind> <name>
ArgumentWhat it is
kindWhich kind. One of stylesheet, script. Required.
nameIts file name. Required.
